game_version: 10/3 Update (heading in the official description read at 2026-10-09 11:13 UTC; matching event listing APM Forest Update 🌲 has a listed start of 2026-10-03 13:50 UTC)
sources_note: 全部实体取自 Roblox 官方公开接口(S 级),2026-10-09 11:12–11:18 UTC 取:游戏描述 games.roblox.com、徽章 badges.roblox.com(8 个,nextPageCursor=null,11:13:30 复取一次 id 一致,awardingUniverse 逐条核对为 2783797267)、通行证 apis.roblox.com/game-passes(14 条,nextPageToken 空;8 条在售,6 条 isForSale=false 且无价格,照实建实体并标 Not for sale)、开发者商品 apis.roblox.com/developer-products v2(11 个,nextPageCursor=null,全部以 [GIFT] 开头)、官方活动 apis.roblox.com/virtual-events(带零起点游标 3 页共 60 条;不带游标只回 3 条)、群组 groups.roblox.com、分级 experience-guidelines-api(POST)。名称逐字复制接口 name / Name / title 字段(含大小写、标点、emoji;4 个徽章同名 Hidden Vehicle,实体 id 按创建先后加 -1 到 -4 区分,name_en 不改)。描述去掉了接口里的换行,用空格连接。徽章 order 按累计获得数降序;通行证 order 先在售(按 Robux 价升序,同价按创建时间)后未在售(按创建时间);商品 order 按价升序。11 个商品里 9 个接口 Description 为空,不写 description_en。game_version 取自描述里的更新标题,games API 的 updated 字段不作补丁日期。车辆名称与性能、车价、游戏币、地图地点、隐藏车位置、白名单操作、完整命令表、私服价格、兑换码均无一手来源,未建实体或记入 unverified_fields。没有任何实体字段把游戏内车辆对应到真实车厂或车型。[round1 / round2 修订 2026-10-09:spawn-slots 默认分配推断已删;update-schedule 的 summary 改为「for nearly every Saturday」并给 next listed start 加 as-of 日期;american-plains-mudding 的 private_servers 未核实项补记 createVipServersAllowed: false;private-server-commands 补记 who may run :admin 未知;Discord 相关内容未写入任何实体。]
_page_slug_note: page_slug 指向 content/en 下实际存在的页(全部已发布,无 draft)。

american-plains-mudding.summary_en: Roblox vehicle roleplay game by the verified group American Plains Mudding: mud pits, towing, farming, boating and off-roading, with trailers and vehicle customization.
american-plains-mudding.description_en: Pioneering vehicles, trailers, and customization on Roblox.
american-plains-mudding.role_en: Developer: American Plains Mudding (verified Roblox group 4548068)
american-plains-mudding.key_notes_en: 15 players per server · Maturity: Minimal · Genre: Simulation / Vehicle Sim · 8 badges · 8 game passes on sale (14 on record) · 11 gift products · Free vehicle offered for a like and a favourite

update-2026-10-03.summary_en: The update notes printed in the official game description on 9 October 2026, under the heading "10/3 Update".
update-2026-10-03.description_en: New ATV (Animated Suspension, Front and Rear Cargo Box Attachments, Windshield Attachment) · New Forest (Map Update Part 1 of 2) · Sitting In Vehicles Requires Being Whitelisted · Bug Fixes (Water Flinging Fixed)
update-2026-10-03.key_notes_en: Matching event listing: APM Forest Update 🌲, listed start Saturday 3 October 2026 at 13:50 UTC

how the new ATV is obtained

free-vehicle-offer.summary_en: The last line of the official game description offers a vehicle for liking and favouriting the game.
free-vehicle-offer.outcome_en: "to obtain a vehicle!" (which vehicle is not stated)
unverified_fields: how and where it is delivered in game

spawn-slots.summary_en: How many vehicles and trailers you can have spawned, according to the official game pass descriptions.
spawn-slots.description_en: Any Slot Spawner: "anything can be spawned in any of the 4-8 slots owned", "with a cap of 8 if 4 trailer and 4 vehicle spawner gamepasses are owned".
spawn-slots.key_notes_en: 4 Vehicle Spawner 490 Robux · 4 Trailer Spawner 290 Robux · Any Slot Spawner 290 Robux · Premium Private Servers: "2x Spawn Slots In Private Servers, Up To 16"
unverified_fields: default split of the base slots (not stated and not derivable from the pass texts)
slot count with no spawner pass or with only one (not stated; 4 is the lowest figure in the stated range)
where spawners are on the map

private-server-commands.summary_en: The three commands printed in the Premium Private Servers game pass description; the description says they are "Some of what is included".
private-server-commands.description_en: :weather storm 1, Spawns Tornadoes, Ranges From 1-10 · :fly user, Fly Any User · :admin user, Give Commands To Any User
private-server-commands.requires_en: Premium Private Servers game pass (195 Robux on 9 October 2026)

update-schedule.summary_en: The developer lists one Roblox event for nearly every Saturday; all 60 listings on record start on a Saturday (UTC).
update-schedule.key_notes_en: 60 listings from 16 August 2025 to 17 October 2026 · 27 of the 30 listings since 28 March 2026 start between 13:45 and 14:15 UTC (our count) · Next listed start as of 9 October 2026: APM Map Update 🗺️, Saturday 10 October 2026 at 14:00 UTC
unverified_fields: whether each update went live at its listed start
whether every listing corresponds to an update
the developer's stated update day (none found in the Roblox sources we could read)
update-schedule.expiry_action: After 2026-10-10 14:00 UTC: re-read the events API and the game description; add the new listing and update the next-start line on the updates and index pages
